name: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Aug)
note: Prices Paid held 71.1. Softer headline, still expansion.

name: ISM Services PMI (Aug)
note: Hotter. Prices 72.6 (4yr high), Emp 47.8 still contraction, New Orders 60.9.

name: Nonfarm Payrolls (Aug)
note: BLS official. U-rate 4.1% unchanged. AHE +0.3% to $37.75 / +3.1% y/y. Participation 61.6%. Revisions: June +20k→+31k, July -23k→+21k (+55k combined). Hot.

name: PPI (Aug)
note: Goods +1.1% (energy +4.2%, diesel +24.1%). Services +0.1%. Final demand less food/energy/trade +0.3%. Hot energy, core softer.

name: CPI (Aug)
note: Headline in-line. Core MoM slightly hot. Gasoline +3.9% drove ~1/3 of rise; energy +2.1%; shelter +0.3%. Core YoY eased to 2.4%.

name: FOMC Rate Decision
note: Unanimous 12-0. SEP median end-2026 4.1% (was 3.8%); 12 of 18 see one more hike this year. Hawkish.

name: Retail Sales (Aug)
note: Hot. Ex-autos +1.4%; control group +1.4%. Strong rebound after July soft.

name: Housing Starts (Aug)
note: Census CB26-147. SF starts 918k +7.6%. Permits 1.394M -2.7%. Completions 1.128M -11.9%. Mixed, not a PATH trigger.

name: Initial Jobless Claims
note: DOL official week ending Sep 12. -10k. 4-wk avg 203,250. Continuing 1.730M / IUR 1.1%. Soft claims, still-tight labor.

name: Philly Fed MBOS (Sep)
note: Still expansion, cooled. New orders 29.2, shipments 27.7. Official Philly Fed 08:30 ET.

name: Industrial Production (Aug)
note: Fed G.17. Flat. Mfg -0.3% (first drop of year), utilities +1.8% (heat). Cap util 76.3%.

name: Initial Jobless Claims
note: Week ending Sep 19. 4-wk avg 202.25k. Continuing 1.719M vs ~1.74M. Soft-to-in-line; not a labor-break. No ISM/JOLTS/ADP/NFP today.

name: No ISM / JOLTS / ADP / claims / NFP
note: Labor/ISM slate is next week (JOLTS Tue 29, ADP/PCE Wed 30, ISM/claims Thu Oct 1, NFP Fri Oct 2). Today: durables 0.0% vs -0.3%; core ex-trans 0.3% vs 0.6%; UMich final 48.1 vs ~47.8. Not stamped as those series.
